releases.title: The Web Interface & Conformance
releases.summary: A new web-based dashboard provides live server stats and release notes, while the server achieves full client-compatibility conformance by resolving the final protocol issues.
highlights: New web dashboard displays live server statistics and LLM-generated release notes.
Achieved full client-compatibility conformance, closing out the P0-P2 issue backlog.
Fixed malformed MODE broadcasts that previously caused missing targets or stray spaces.
Session counting in the web view now accurately reflects only registered users.

releases.title: Accounts, TLS, and Identity
releases.summary: Chonkline now supports secure connections via TLS, user accounts with SASL authentication, and proper server identity, making it a more robust home for regulars.
highlights: Secure TLS connections available on port 6697 via a ghostunnel sidecar.
Added user accounts with SASL authentication and IRCv3 capabilities.
Host cloaking is now supported to protect user privacy.
Server identity is properly advertised via IRC_SERVER_NAME and RPL_LUSERHOST.
Fixed RPL_USERHOST to correctly include user@host for strict clients.

releases.title: ChanServ, MOTD, and NOTICE Fixes
releases.summary: Channel registration is now managed by ChanServ, the Message of the Day is cleaner, and private messages (NOTICE) are delivered reliably to all users.
highlights: New ChanServ service allows for proper channel registration.
MOTD is now trimmed to remove unnecessary closing lines for a cleaner read.
Fixed NOTICE delivery so private messages and CTCP replies reach the intended users.
Ensured RPL_MOTDSTART is sent before the MOTD body to prevent client crashes.

releases.title: Protocol Polish & Stability
releases.summary: The core connection experience is smoother with faster reconnections, reliable channel buffers, and fixes for common protocol quirks that caused ghost users or missed events.
highlights: Hardened reconnection logic with keepalives and fast nick reclaim.
Clients now see their own JOIN and PART events, ensuring channel buffers open correctly.
Improved CAP negotiation and PING/PONG handling for a stable handshake.
Fixed error-numeric targets and ghost user reaping for stricter client compatibility.
